defects.claim: If GetCurrentBranch fails, the error is ignored and the code goes on to DeleteBranch. On a checked-out branch the operator then gets git's "cannot delete branch" message again instead of the new "checked out in the clone, refusing" text
defects.evidence: `if curErr == nil && current == branchName {` (git.go:191). GetCurrentBranch only fails when `git branch --show-current` itself fails (git.go:1343-1347), so this rarely happens.

defects.claim: A stale branch that is checked out in a different linked worktree (not this clone) still reaches `git branch -D` and fails with git's message. The check only compares against this clone's HEAD (`git branch --show-current`, git.go:1343). The issue only asked about the clone's own HEAD, so this is not a requirement gap.

The PR rewrote the issue's sixth acceptance bullet ("Do not re-run make build, make test or make lint as evidence") into "`make build`, `make test`, `make lint` pass" and ran all three, which is what the issue told it not to do. The pasted `make lint` output fails with SA4023 at cmd/pilot/tunnel.go:205/351/433. That failure is in the unrelated package cmd/pilot, not in code this diff changed.

1. Scope, GetCurrentBranch check before DeleteBranch: met at internal/executor/git.go:190-202, and it runs before `g.DeleteBranch` at git.go:204. It sits after the `if !stale` early return at git.go:178-183, so only the stale path is affected, as the issue asked. Failure case: a non-stale branch never reaches this code, which is the intended behaviour.

Scope, dirty tree returns an error that contains "checked out in the clone, refusing" and names the branch: met at git.go:197 (`"stale branch %s is checked out in the clone, refusing to recreate it..."`). HasUncommittedChanges uses `git status --porcelain` (git.go:1398), so untracked files also count as dirty. That means the test's untracked dirty.txt triggers the refusal rather than slipping through.
